concepts.gloss_en: Repentance out of love (as opposed to repentance out of fear)

reason_for_human: All 5 occurrences carry identical vocalization (תְּשׁוּבָה מֵאַהֲבָה) and identical meaning — repentance motivated by love, explicitly contrasted with repentance from fear (מיראה) in the Sotah 31a citation. The single בתשובה מאהבה is just the same phrase with the prefix ב ('through repentance from love'), a grammatical variant, not a homograph. Safe to merge.
